list.name: site_id
list.label: Site
list.query: SELECT site_name AS __text, site_id AS __value FROM analytics.v_grafana_sites WHERE grafana_org_id = ${__org.id} ORDER BY site_name
list.definition: SELECT site_name AS __text, site_id AS __value FROM analytics.v_grafana_sites WHERE grafana_org_id = ${__org.id} ORDER BY site_name

list.name: area_id
list.label: Area
list.query:
WITH areas AS (
    SELECT
        hierarchy_path AS __text,
        asset_id::text AS __value
    FROM analytics.v_grafana_assets
    WHERE grafana_org_id = ${__org.id}
      AND site_id::text = '$site_id'
      AND child_count > 0
)
SELECT __text, __value
FROM areas

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'No areas configured for this site' AS __text,
    '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS __value
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM areas)

ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: WITH RECURSIVE d AS (SELECT asset_id,parent_asset_id FROM analytics.v_grafana_assets WHERE grafana_org_id = ${__org.id} AND asset_id::text = '$area_id' UNION ALL SELECT a.asset_id,a.parent_asset_id FROM analytics.v_grafana_assets a JOIN d ON a.parent_asset_id=d.asset_id WHERE a.grafana_org_id = ${__org.id}) SELECT greatest(count(*)-1,0) FROM d

WITH RECURSIVE d AS (SELECT asset_id FROM analytics.v_grafana_assets WHERE grafana_org_id = ${__org.id} AND asset_id::text = '$area_id' UNION ALL SELECT a.asset_id FROM analytics.v_grafana_assets a JOIN d ON a.parent_asset_id=d.asset_id WHERE a.grafana_org_id = ${__org.id}) SELECT count(*) FROM analytics.v_grafana_asset_devices ad WHERE ad.grafana_org_id = ${__org.id} AND ad.asset_id IN (SELECT asset_id FROM d)

WITH RECURSIVE d AS (SELECT asset_id FROM analytics.v_grafana_assets WHERE grafana_org_id = ${__org.id} AND asset_id::text = '$area_id' UNION ALL SELECT a.asset_id FROM analytics.v_grafana_assets a JOIN d ON a.parent_asset_id=d.asset_id WHERE a.grafana_org_id = ${__org.id}) SELECT sum(active_power_kw) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (asset_id) asset_id,active_power_kw FROM analytics.v_grafana_energy_samples WHERE grafana_org_id = ${__org.id} AND asset_id IN (SELECT asset_id FROM d) ORDER BY asset_id,sample_time DESC) q

WITH RECURSIVE d AS (SELECT asset_id FROM analytics.v_grafana_assets WHERE grafana_org_id = ${__org.id} AND asset_id::text = '$area_id' UNION ALL SELECT a.asset_id FROM analytics.v_grafana_assets a JOIN d ON a.parent_asset_id=d.asset_id WHERE a.grafana_org_id = ${__org.id}) SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(sample_time,'15m'),sum(active_power_kw) AS demand_kw FROM analytics.v_grafana_energy_samples WHERE grafana_org_id = ${__org.id} AND asset_id IN (SELECT asset_id FROM d) AND $__timeFilter(sample_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
